Quick take from product/infra perspective — doable with constraints:

- Recommendation: Put the route on a Dedicated pool (reserved capacity) in US-EAST with a dedicated model variant and set an explicit allocation of GPUs to meet the target qps. That gives the most predictable p95.
- Autoscale: allow a small burst buffer (20%) but require explicit overage pricing beyond that.
- Fallbacks: propose a two-tier fallback: 1) quantized model variant with graceful degradation for non-critical fields, 2) hard-rate-limit only as last resort. Need Cobalt to accept a documented fidelity delta in the SLA.
- Runbook: we will need a runbook (production playbook) covering detection thresholds (error rate, latency percentiles), rollback criteria, and contact escalation (named Redwood on-call). I can put a draft together — estimated 3 engineering-days to validate with a load test.
- Cost: ballpark uplift for Dedicated + 20% buffer + 24/7 on-call & SRE readiness: $35k–$50k/mo depending on committed usage. We should model two pricing tiers in the doc.

I can lead the load test plan and produce an ops checklist. If Marissa agrees on commercial terms, we should get legal engaged to start a redline.

— Karthik
